audience: Oslo skincare buyers who notice a premium finish

copy_lines.text: Ren glød, laget for huden din

hypothesis: an AI-made studio hero shot drives at least as many orders as a costlier human shoot
insight: a credible studio product shot signals quality faster than claims do

maker_recommendation.rationale: a human studio shoot needs 36 more orders to cover its cost, about 40% of the goal, so AI-made visuals carry the volume

mandatories.text: If a real person's skin is altered, carry the retusjert reklame label.
For EU reach, label realistic AI-made people under Article 50.

objective: launch Aurora's new serum line in Oslo
open_questions: is 90 orders reachable on 40 000 kr at the assumed conversion rate?
proposition: a premium studio look that moves 90 orders
